rule: Do not add boolean props (isThread, isEditing, ...) to customize component behavior; use composition.
gap: Name-pattern heuristic (isX/hasX/showX/shouldX typed boolean in a props type); cannot tell props types from other types and misses other names. react/boolean-prop-naming only enforces naming, does not forbid booleans.

rule: Structure complex components as compound components with a shared context.
Subcomponents read shared state via context, not props.
State, actions and meta are dependency-injected by a parent provider so a structure can be reused.
The provider is the only place that knows how state is managed; UI components must not call state-implementation hooks (e.g. useGlobalChannelState).
gap: Which hooks are 'implementation' is project specific; could be a project-specific no-restricted-imports but not generic.
notes: Also covers the same point in state-context-interface.md (UI consumes the interface, not the implementation).
